headline: Hybrid Theory leads at the turn-12 cap after commander-killing Divergent Laughter

result.summary: Overwhelming Denial counters Sin on turn 6. Indoraptor with Eternal Thirst commander-kills Divergent Laughter on turn 10 (24 commander damage). The cap hits with Hybrid Theory at 71, Tea Party at 33, Sin-fall at 22, and Divergent Laughter dead.

seats.plan: Enrage attrition. Bloodthirst Indoraptor, Eternal Thirst, commander damage.

seats.plan: Hold first instant/sorcery, Alania copies, Jaya or Tasha finish.
